name: Jordan Rivera
paragraphs: Your posting for a Director of AI Enablement says the goal is to move AI "from pilots to the way we work." That shift is exactly what I've spent the last two years doing.

At Example Consulting Group I lead three delivery teams rolling out an internal AI assistant to 4,000 users at a large insurer. We cut request-to-release time 35% by adding gated planning, automated checks and weekly metric reviews, and that evidence secured funding for a second year.

Before that I owned the roadmap for a claims data platform through six on-time releases, starting from discovery workshops with more than 40 stakeholders. I'm comfortable running the whole arc, from figuring out what to build to proving it worked.
I'd welcome a conversation about how I could help your teams make AI part of everyday delivery.
